description: Sample topics and test prompts for Copilot Studio agent validation

topics.name: FindTrainingGuide
triggerPhrases: where is the cursor training guide
topics.expectedBehavior: Return path to Cursor training materials in SharePoint; link or folder path

topics.name: ClaudePortalAccess
topics.expectedBehavior: Steps from connected docs: IT portal, SSO, approved URL — no consumer claude.ai unless policy allows

topics.name: MSTRDailyReport
topics.expectedBehavior: Point to MSTR report SOP or training deck section if indexed

topics.name: CopilotSetup
topics.expectedBehavior: High-level steps: license, Copilot Studio, SharePoint knowledge, publish to Teams

topics.name: FolderNavigation
topics.expectedBehavior: Folder path + file name from knowledge sources; admit uncertainty if not found

testPrompts: Where is the Q3 forecast template?
How do I get access to the Claude AI portal?
What's the MSTR daily report workflow?
How do I integrate Claude with Excel?
Which SharePoint folder has the Cursor onboarding deck?
How do we set up a Copilot agent for our team?
